text:
It sounds like you are experiencing a disconnect where you are getting your meals but not actually eating them, and that makes sense if you are feeling overwhelmed or disconnected from the experience of eating. It is understandable that if you don't remember eating, it can feel like you are losing track of what is happening. You might try focusing on the sensory experience of your food, like noticing the taste or texture of each bite, even if it's just for a few minutes. You could try setting a very simple reminder to pause and notice your food before you take a bite. Perhaps you could start by focusing on just one meal a day and trying to be fully present with that one meal.
